entity.name: Emir Mrkaljević
entity.description: Independent software developer. I build and maintain small open-source developer tools: behave (CLI behavioural conformance testing), usb-rea (USB protocol reverse engineering) and mesh2cad.

projects.name: behave
projects.description: behave records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, files, exit codes, stdout/stderr, edge cases) by generating test cases from its --help and man page, stores them as readable YAML, and replays them against another implementation to show, per flag, where a rewrite differs. It is aimed at memory-safe rewrites of core tools (e.g. uutils coreutils, gojq) and at regression testing of CLIs. Status: early (v0.1.x). Results so far include compatibility bugs reported to uutils/coreutils with fixes merged upstream (#15345, #15381).

plans.description: One-time grant for ~330 hours at EUR 30/hour toward behave 1.0: hermetic, reproducible recordings (fixed env/locale/time, isolated filesystem, flake detection); better case generation and shrinking; a public corpus of recordings for GNU coreutils and jq; stable JSON/JUnit output, CI integration, packaging and docs.
